observed: Result: Blocked on production (v26.43.0-ffea43c). The test expects a density record for Board View, and this release has no density in Board View.
Set-up: as the test user, in Board View > Fields to display, VIN/serial was turned on and the user went back to List; then a fresh session was started.

Steps 1 and 2: opening Work Orders and clicking Board View recorded 13 field records, one per optional Board View field (lead technician, customer, asset, VIN/serial, progress, service advisor, clocked in, line count, line technicians, estimated hours, total price, on-site, created date). VIN/serial reads on with source saved; the other 12 read source default.

Step 2 (density): no density record was recorded for Board View. The current product document says: "Board View shows no Density control in this release (SV-11580)." (PRD v73, S3-R11, read 22 Oct 2026). The product follows that document; the test's expected result predates it.
Steps 3 and 4: clicking Tech View recorded 17 field records (Tech View's columns, including Assigned Techs) and 1 density record (Regular, default).
Steps 5 to 8: Board View, List and Board View again recorded no new field records and no new density records. Field records for the session: 13 + 17 = 30.
C97024.failed_steps: Blocked at step 2: the test expects one density record for Board View, and this release has no density in Board View (PRD v73, S3-R11), so none is recorded. Everything else in the test is met.
